item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We refuse to accept that outcome. Our future must remain ours to decide.

2. We cannot hand power to machines more intelligent than humanity and expect to remain in charge. Building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years means permanently surrendering our future. We must stop that from happening.

3. We stand for a future shaped by people, not dictated by superintelligent machines. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, we will lose control for good. We demand that humanity’s future come before the race to build it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe humanity’s future belongs to humanity. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, we will permanently lose control of that future. This is not another technological transition we can navigate after the fact. It is the surrender of our ability to decide what comes next, for ourselves and for every generation that follows. We reject the idea that this outcome is inevitable or that racing toward it counts as progress. We must stop the development of superintelligent AI before it crosses that threshold. Together, we can insist on limits that preserve human control, rather than accepting promises that leave our future beyond our reach.
